description: On October 7th, the New Hampshire chapter of the Sierra Club released its list of carefully selected endorsed candidates for Governor, Executive Council, State Senate, and State House of Representatives. All of the endorsed candidates share concern for the New Hampshire environment, support action on climate solutions that benefits all residents, and a vision to lower pollution thus protecting public health and wildlife.
